title: The Same Person, Beginning Again
subtitle: Starting over does not require replacing yourself
sourceCredit: Leah Baruch · The Moth Radio Hour, “Starting Over”

shot.title: Two versions of a future
shot.direction: The real woman sits among bankruptcy papers; an impossibly immaculate doctor exists only in a thought image.
shot.soundDirection: Raindrops on stone, a dull fall, then pen strokes and a steady cane tap.

illustration.direction: Wide modest home study. The real woman sits amid a few unmarked financial papers, shoulders slumped. On the empty wall beyond her is a faint clean white-coat silhouette of an imagined ideal doctor, clearly separate and translucent. She looks toward it without becoming it; hands rest naturally on paper.

shot.title: The imagined ideal
shot.direction: A paper stirs toward the separate ideal, emphasizing the distance she has imagined.
shot.soundDirection: Raindrops on stone, a dull fall, then pen strokes and a steady cane tap.

beats.caption: The person who becomes a doctor won’t be this person.
beats.speaker: WOMAN

shot.title: Not this person

illustration.direction: Wide quiet outdoor path after rain. Same woman in unchanged clothes steps onto a slick stone, foot beginning one small slip as she reaches for balance. shot.title: The ankle gives
shot.direction: A single readable slip and off-balance recovery, without prolonged injury spectacle.

shot.title: The ideal breaks
shot.direction: The imagined doctor disappears; the real person remains with the injury.
shot.soundDirection: Raindrops on stone, a dull fall, then pen strokes and a steady cane tap.

illustration.direction: She sits safely on a low stone edge after the slip, one hand lightly supporting her ankle and the other bracing her weight on the stone. Her face shows ordinary pain and disappointment. The imagined ideal is absent; no miraculous cure, graphic injury or collapse is added.

beats.caption: Now I’ve ruined even the restart.
beats.speaker: WOMAN

shot.title: Even the restart
shot.direction: Let disappointment land. Do not rush directly into determination.

shot.title: The book within reach
shot.direction: She pulls a study book closer before changing her belief about herself.

illustration.direction: Back in her modest home, same recognizable woman seated at a desk, cane leaning within reach against the chair. She pulls a plain study book toward her with one hand while the other steadies its edge. The financial papers remain a small real stack, not magically vanished.

actions.direction: Her gaze settles toward the real book, then the hand resting on its cover makes a small deliberate adjustment. The book and the walking aid remain supported and still.

beats.caption: Maybe I can begin without becoming someone else.
beats.speaker: WOMAN

shot.title: Beginning as herself
shot.direction: The thought changes through studying, not a makeover or removal of the cane.
shot.soundDirection: Raindrops on stone, a dull fall, then pen strokes and a steady cane tap.

illustration.direction: Same desk and woman, reading a study book with pencil contacting a notebook, grounded feet and careful posture. Cane remains clearly beside the chair. Her expression is focused and modestly steadier; no white-coat makeover, diploma or altered body signals success.

actions.direction: A short real writing phrase follows a gentle head inclination. Her other hand holds the book open. The aid, table and cup stay fixed; no movement implies a sudden cure.

shot.title: Standing with the cane
shot.direction: She places weight carefully and gains her balance with the cane visible.
shot.soundDirection: Raindrops on stone, a dull fall, then pen strokes and a steady cane tap.

illustration.direction: Wide school approach. The woman stands carefully using the cane in one hand and carrying her study book in the other, taking one slow balanced step toward the entrance. Her face, cardigan, hair and body remain unchanged; the cane is visible and weight bearing, not discarded.

beats.caption: I’m still here. I can still go.
beats.speaker: WOMAN

shot.title: I can still go
shot.direction: She proceeds slowly toward school using the aid; do not imply instant healing.
